scientific_integrity: Complete symbolic arguments and a reproducible exhaustive checker are included; the literature comparison is not a proof of absolute novelty. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts finite normal modal algebras with a fixed number of Boolean atoms and modal identity \(\Box^3 0=1\); excludes unbounded height. Algebraic isomorphism counts do not assert distinctness of the associated splitting logics. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove general formulas.
title: Canonical two-step normal form and census of finite modal splitting templates
